note: Complexity debt baseline: functions with CCN > 15 or NLOC > 80, keyed file::function (no line numbers), plus grandfathered swiftlint:disable counts for the size/complexity rules. The nightly REPORTS offenders not on this list; the pre-commit hook and CI preflight BLOCK new or worse functions over the gate limits (scripts/complexity_gate.py). It only shrinks (`--shrink-baseline`); regrow it deliberately with `scripts/complexity_metrics.py --update-baseline` and say why in the commit.
